scope: Read-only comparison of local business content and assets with the consolidated site. Full backup and deletion guards require a separate review.

findings.detail: The local checkout has no favicon.png. The consolidated repository includes the expected favicon.
Superseded hero/demo markup, generators, historical records/screenshots, VCS state and local caches are retained in complete local backups. They are not all copied into the consolidated runtime.
